guide.immortalstorage.jade.title: Ancient Jade Legacy
guide.immortalstorage.jade.page.1:
Awakening

Find the Ancient Jade in village relics. Carry it for a full day, or sleep beside it, to sense qi and enter stage one.
guide.immortalstorage.jade.page.2:
Qi and Kongqiao

At stages one to five, use pills to gather lingqi. Press B to open Kongqiao; capacity grows by stage and crafting unlocks at stage three.
guide.immortalstorage.jade.page.3:
Xianqiao

At stage six, B opens the Xianqiao terminal. It aggregates exact component variants and provides search, sorting, smooth storage, crafting, and furnace modules.
guide.immortalstorage.jade.page.4:
Yuan

True and Immortal Yuan regenerate from cultivation and spirit cores, each under its own cap. Equipment validates the available balance before spending it.
guide.immortalstorage.jade.page.5:
Tools and Furnace

The Spirit Sword spends yuan for bonus damage. Shift+wheel changes Spirit Instrument mode. The Immortal Furnace burns True or Immortal Yuan items.
guide.immortalstorage.jade.page.6:
Personal Realm

Press V to enter or leave your Xianqiao. From stage seven, the terminal can raise its dimension-bound time rate up to 16x.

guide.immortalstorage.jade.chapter.progr: Cultivation Stages
The core path from Ancient Jade awakening to stage 10.

The Ancient Jade reveals new writing as cultivation deepens. Carry it to awaken, nourish Kongqiao with lingqi, learn inner crafting and gathering, then cross the mortal-immortal boundary with the Immortal Furnace and an Immortal Pill. From stage 6 onward, cultivate a realm of your own and pass four tribulations.

B opens your current personal storage from anywhere. V shows lingqi and, after ascension, also enters or leaves the personal realm. Ordinary cultivation through stage 6 never falls backward. A failed tribulation preserves stage and possessions but empties current Immortal Yuan.
stage,lingqi,pill,breakthrough,keybind,ancient jade
Cultivator's Notes
Advice left in the jade for each step of the path.

A mortal awakens by carrying the jade through a day and night, or by sleeping beside it. Stage 1 asks for 120 lingqi, stage 2 for 360, stage 3 for 1440, and stage 4 for 2560; Kongqiao grows from nine slots to eighteen, thirty-six, and fifty-four while each slot grows deeper.

At stage 3 the crafting jade tab reveals a 3x3 grid. At stage 4 Management reveals the drop magnet. Stage 5 provides seventy-two slots: fill all 10420 lingqi and eat an Immortal Pill. A Breakthrough Pill may fill lingqi but cannot perform ascension.

Ascension converts the True Yuan carried or stored at that moment sixteen to one and moves every possession into Xianqiao. The personal realm measures 3x3 chunks at stage 6, 7x7 with fluids at stage 7, 19x19 at stage 8, and becomes unbounded at stage 9. Settle the realm and gather Immortal Yuan before invoking each trial.

The four foes are Zombie, Wither Skeleton, Vindicator, and Warden, each with tenfold health; the Vindicator also bears Resistance. If you fall, you awaken in place with stage and possessions intact, but current Immortal Yuan is gone. At stage 10 the jade will tell whether Yuan condenses over time or has become inexhaustible.

True and Immortal Yuan
Physical Yuan items, total caps, and automation access.

TruePower and ImmortalPower are physical forms of Yuan that may be carried, stored, crafted, and offered to machines. One ImmortalPower crafts into sixty-four TruePower. Right-click a block face to consume one and leave a white floating light: TruePower shines at level 8, while ImmortalPower shines at level 15 and suppresses natural hostile spawning in that chunk. Dye changes its color, an empty hand hides the core, and breaking returns nothing.

After stage 6, True Yuan no longer grows naturally but has no storage bound. Ascension converts existing True Yuan sixteen to one only at that moment. Stage 10 ordinarily condenses 256 Immortal Yuan every 20 ticks without a capacity bound; under the inexhaustible law it may instead be drawn forever without diminishing.
true yuan,immortal yuan,cap,conversion,crafting,automation
Ascension and Advancement
The stage-5 to stage-6 storage and Yuan transition.

Stage 5 still uses a finite 72-slot Kongqiao. Stage 5 never advances from ordinary lingqi alone: first fill its lingqi progress, then eat an Immortal Pill. Using it too early causes lethal backlash. A Breakthrough Pill at stage 5 only fills lingqi and cannot replace the Immortal Pill.

Successful ascension is one atomic boundary: every current TruePower item in inventory and Kongqiao converts at sixteen to one ImmortalPower, discarding an incomplete remainder, and all Kongqiao stacks migrate before aggregated Xianqiao storage becomes active. TruePower acquired later never auto-converts.

guide.immortalstorage.jade.chapter.stora: Stage 1-5 item storage and embedded crafting.

Kongqiao stores items only: it has no fluid channel and cannot use the Xianqiao Manager. Stage capacities are 9, 18, 36, 54, and 72 slots; stage 3 unlocks an embedded 3x3 crafting grid.

Shift-click moves full stacks between inventory and Kongqiao. Closing must safely return all real crafting ingredients.
Shared item/fluid page, search, sorting, and smooth scrolling.

Xianqiao aggregates totals by item identity and complete Data Components. Items and fluids share one directory page, with fluids displayed in buckets. Wheel and thumb dragging scroll continuously; the network prefetches twice the visible rows while rendering only visible content.

Crafting, Immortal Furnace, and Xianqiao Management remain modules of the same terminal. Management contains realm time, tribulation, and held-stack refill: an exhausted selected stack refills only from an exact complete-Data-Components identity.
Collect nearby drops through whitelist or blacklist rules.

The management page can enable the magnet and select blacklist or whitelist behavior. Matching dropped items enter Xianqiao storage transactionally; a failed complete insertion must never silently delete an item.
guide.immortalstorage.jade.chapter.resou: Three work lanes, Yuan fuel, and vanilla progress indicators.

The Immortal Furnace has three independent work lanes and accepts vanilla furnace and blast-furnace recipes except ImmortalStorage recipes. It burns only True or Immortal Yuan and can auto-consume Immortal Yuan in Xianqiao contexts.

True Yuan smelts one item per lane in 50 ticks and burns for 150 ticks. Immortal Yuan smelts one stack per lane in 25 ticks and burns for 500 ticks. Use a held Immortal Spirit Drive to bind it; in a placed furnace it pays from the owner's personal storage, preferring Immortal Yuan then True Yuan. If empty it retries every five ticks, and the drive itself is never consumed.
Independent caches, per-face output, and standard capability access.

Every placed Source Vein remains independently usable and owns a real long-valued cache. All faces default off; off stops active transfer but does not reject passive extraction by storage buses or pipes.

Each face independently selects push, bypass-limit push, or off. Every block has its own numeric rate and clamps values above the configured maximum.
Source Vein Manager, Xianqiao Manager, and Xianqiao Interface.

The Source Vein Manager can exist only in a personal realm and has 72 single-item slots, allowing one source of each name. It aggregates member products into an extract-only storage view bound to Xianqiao statistics.

The Xianqiao Manager binds player storage. The Xianqiao Interface may be placed in other dimensions and connects configured targets and caches to Xianqiao, with pull, push, or off configured independently per face.
A full gameplay-purpose index that does not require a recipe viewer.

Ancient Jade starts cultivation and opens this guide. Pill Embryos and Pills support furnace processing and advancement; every pill is fast and edible at full hunger. TruePower and ImmortalPower are physical energy, ingredients, machine fuel, and placeable lights. Spirit Iron, Crude Spirit Iron, Spirit Crystal, their ores, and storage blocks form the material chain. Spirit Core stacks to sixteen and is only an intermediate ingredient.

The Spirit Instrument has Explore, Wrench, Pick, and Build modes. The Spirit Sword derives bonus damage from stage and paid power. The Immortal Spirit Drive binds an owner and remotely fuels placed Immortal Furnaces. White Day Thunder is associated with tribulation.

The Immortal Furnace has three lanes. Xianqiao Manager binds personal storage. Xianqiao Interface provides configured caches and adjacent automation. Source blocks output budgeted or unlimited resources; the Source Manager aggregates 72 unique sources. The World Shard Miner reads world ore rules, while a Treasure Basin above an active miner independently gathers loot. Storage blocks craft both ways with nine matching materials.
guide.immortalstorage.jade.chapter.tools: Explore, wrench, pick, and build modes.

Shift-wheel changes Spirit Instrument mode. In Explore mode, right-click air to toggle collection. While enabled, keep the instrument in either hand when opening a loot container to transactionally collect that player's current page into personal storage. Wrench mode uses public wrench conventions and Shift-right-clicks owned ImmortalStorage blocks to dismantle them.

Pick mode has netherite mining level; from stage 6, right-click spends one Immortal Yuan to silk-harvest the targeted block. Build mode uses the same server plan for validation and outlines, taking materials transactionally, with a default 64-block limit.
Sword damage, Spirit Repair, and persistent effects.

Spirit Sword bonus damage uses the same model shown in its tooltip and validates available Yuan when attacking. Spirit Sword and Spirit Instrument are crafted with Spirit Repair, which spends Yuan to restore durability. The item tooltip is authoritative for the exact formula and bounds.
guide.immortalstorage.jade.chapter.realm: UUID-bound dimensions, stage boundaries, and stage-specific time scales.

Each personal realm is bound to one player UUID. Stage 6 provides 3x3 chunks, stage 7 expands to 7x7, and stage 8 expands to 19x19. Stages 6-8 draw a vanilla world border at the outer chunk edge. Touching it displays a boundary notice; an abnormal crossing teleports the player to the nearest legal position. Boundary checks run only while the owner is inside that exact realm. Stage 9 removes the spatial border and becomes unlimited.

Stage 7 gears are 0.5x, 1x, 2x, and 4x. Stage 8 adds 0.2x and 8x. Stage 9 ranges from 0.1x to 16x. Stage 10 supports 0x, 0.1x, 0.2x, 0.5x, 1x, 2x, 4x, 8x, 16x, and 32x. Slowdown and 0x freeze affect only the personal realm and never prevent leaving it.
A stage challenge available only inside the personal realm.

Tribulation begins only inside the owner's personal realm and suspends Cultivation buffs and flight. One target is bound to the player and attempt id: it glows permanently, has Strength III, and exactly ten times its original base health. Only its death advances the stage; failure clears current Immortal Yuan without lowering stage.

Defaults are Zombie for 6-7, Wither Skeleton for 7-8, Vindicator for 8-9, and Warden for 9-10. The 8-9 Vindicator also has Resistance I. Stage 8-9 applies Blindness to the player; 9-10 applies Blindness and Wither. In every game mode, tribulation death cleans the target, retains items, and revives the player in place.
The ore miner and its independently operating basin above.

The World Shard Miner activates on a complete same-block beacon base in any dimension and reads current world ore rules. In a personal realm output enters owner storage; elsewhere it fills an internal cache and stops when full.

The Treasure Basin only examines the active miner directly below to select its loot mode; the two blocks do not actively communicate. The basin owns a separate cache and may block the beacon beam.
Recipe viewers, storage disks, and energy/resource integrations.

The terminal supports JEI and EMI R/U lookup, ingredient highlighting, search synchronization, exclusion areas, and recipe transfer. With no viewer installed, these features disable safely.

AE2 and RS use Xianqiao exchange disks bound to the player's stable long ID. Energy, chemicals, Source, mana, and Soul Surge integrations load independently only when their target mod is installed.
